title: Bring the scripted walks back in line with the split panel
goal: Fourteen of the app's 281 scripted walks now fail, all of them because the Shadow moved out of Appearance and into the Effects list on 2026-09-07 and the walks still look for it where it used to be. Until they are green again the walk suite cannot tell a real regression from this one, so nobody can trust it to catch a mistake.
notes:
Baselined on 2026-09-07 by stashing an unrelated change and re-running: all five sampled walks fail identically without it, so none of this is new work. Full run: Scripts/playtest-all.sh, 281 walks in 46m36s, 267 passed, 14 failed.

The fourteen and why:

  press Switch in "Shadow" -> the ones that are: none
    parts-off-is-remembered-walk (step 45), parts-settings-inline-walk (step 10), switch-says-mixed-walk (step 13)
  dragColor onto "Shadow" -> no colour swatch for "Shadow"
    colour-onto-an-off-part-walk (step 23)
  dragColor onto "Library" -> stayed dark
    colour-off-the-shelf-walk (step 13), colour-onto-the-library-walk (step 15)
  press "Limits" / "Stack" -> not where a person could click it (dock got taller, control fell below the fold)
    clip-contents-walk (step 12), out-of-view-mark-walk (step 8), size-limits-walk (step 14), contents-for-several-walk (step 58)
  expect "Apply to Other Versions" reads "Shadow, there is something to carry", not "there is something to carry"
    component-whole-path-walk (step 167) -- the new Shadow row lends its word to the detail, so the claim needs the row name in it
  waitFor sectionInView("Text") timed out
    dock-picked-first-walk (step 47)
  selectRow "Photonz drop probe 2" -> only Background in the list
    region-keeps-your-layer-walk (step 78)
  hover tooltip starting "Inspector" -> not on screen (it is "Hide Panel" now)
    tool-tips (step 13)

The last four are not obviously the split and may each be their own thing; check them before assuming.
acceptance: Each walk was updated to press the control where it lives now, not deleted or skipped
Any walk that fails for a reason that is NOT the panel split is filed as its own bug with the output that shows it
